Line 644 `p += wh * Wosize_hd(hd)` skips N following blocks. Applied fix: after line 644, added new line 645 with `p += wh;` to advance past current free block; line 649 in else branch keeps `p += Whsize_hd(hd);` for live blocks. However, this fix still causes segmentation fault during bootstrap at camlinternalFormatBasics.cmi compilation.
